ignoreCommand: bash -c 'set -e; ref="$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF"; msg="$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE"; if [ "$ref" != "main" ] && [ "$ref" != "master" ]; then echo "Skip deploy for branch $ref"; exit 0; fi; case "$msg" in *"[skip ci]"*|*"[ci skip]"*|*"[skip vercel]"*) echo "Skip deploy: commit marked skip"; exit 0;; esac; exit 1'
